caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of a grid arrangement featuring geometric shapes and repeated motifs. The design utilizes three main colors: dark blue, red, and off-white or beige. There are vertical and horizontal bands, each section filled with alternating colors and small rectangular units. Dark blue and red squares are positioned at regular intervals, creating checkerboard effects. The pattern includes vertical columns with diamond and oval motifs outlined in blue and interspersed with blocks of red cross or plus shapes. Other sections of the composition are filled with dense horizontal blue and red stripes. The textile is rendered with visible woven texture giving the impression of thread interlacing, and the overall background outside the textile square is a plain light tan with no additional elements, except for a small inscription "Chas Roadman" in the lower right corner.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
